title: New interpretations for Kromatic symmetric function expansions
summary: The Kromatic symmetric function (KSF) $\overline{X}_{G}$, introduced by Crew, Pechenik, and Spirkl (2026), is a $K$-theoretic analogue of the chromatic symmetric function (CSF) $X_G$. We study expansion formulas for the KSF in two different bases. First, we explore recursive ways to compute the KSF's expansion in the $K$-theoretic monomial symmetric function basis $\overline{\widetilde{m}}_λ$, generalizing formulas that were used by the second author and Samanta to show that the KSF distinguishes certain families of graphs that are not distinguished by the CSF.
